Hi all — quick summary from lockbox: the $36,225.00 partial payment from ScaleOps was auto-applied to customer code SC-7002 (internal batch 20270912-B) instead of SC-7021 (ScaleOps). The remittance detail had INV-2041 buried in line items and our parser favored the customer code over invoice lines.

What I found:
- Applied to: AR account SC-7002
- Incorrect VAT tag: posted as VAT-exempt when invoice is standard-rated (20%)
- Unapplied / misapplied amount: $36,225.00 (partial of INV-2041)

I prepared a proposed adjustment workbook with suggested reversal and reapply rows. Please review before I draft the journal.

Attached: AR_Adjustment_INV2041.xlsx (xlsx) — tabs: lockbox_export, reversal_rows, reapply_rows, audit_notes.

Subject: Re: Remittance mismatch on INV-2041 — allocation request

Thanks Marcus — reviewed the workbook. Proposed journal to fix VAT mapping and move the applied payment to the correct AR customer code:

Suggested Journal (to be posted in accounting system):
- JNL date: 2027-09-18
- Reference: INV-2041 reclass — JNL-POST
- Lines:
  1) Debit AR (SC-7002) $36,225.00 — reverse application
  2) Credit Cash Clearing (lockbox) $36,225.00 — to clear reversal
  3) Debit Cash Clearing $36,225.00 — reapply
  4) Credit AR (SC-7021) $36,225.00 — apply to correct customer/invoice
- VAT correction: record VAT payable adjustment of 20% on the re-applied portion; see revmap: revmap-24-standard-eu

I exported a CSV that matches our JNL loader. If Laura approves, I will load and schedule posting for 2027-09-18 EOD.

Attached: proposed_journal_INV2041.csv (csv)

Mina Haddad
